text: {"rules":[{"id":"STATIN-PRIMARY-PREV-40-75","version":"August 2022","title":"Statin use for primary prevention of CVD in adults aged 40 to 75 with 1 or more CVD risk factors and 10-year CVD risk of 10% or greater","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends that clinicians prescribe a statin for the primary prevention of CVD for adults aged 40 to 75 years who have 1 or more CVD risk factors (i.e. dyslipidemia, diabetes, hypertension, or smoking) and an estimated 10-year risk of a cardiovascular event of 10% or greater.","grade":"B","effective_date":"2022-08","action":"Prescribe a statin for the primary prevention of CVD","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"age\": {\"min\": 40, \"max\": 75, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"adults aged 40 to 75 years\"}, {\"any\": [{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"dyslipidemia\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"dyslipidemia\"}, {\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"diabetes\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"diabetes\"}, {\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"hypertension\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"hypertension\"}, {\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"current_smoker\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"smoking\", \"note\": \"'smoking' risk factor mapped to current_smoker\"}], \"quote\": \"1 or more CVD risk factors\"}, {\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"cvd_risk_10yr\", \"window\": [\"{MY-4}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"], \"pick\": \"latest\", \"value\": {\"op\": \">=\", \"threshold\": 10, \"unit\": \"%\"}}, \"quote\": \"an estimated 10-year risk of a cardiovascular event of 10% or greater\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text states no lookback for the risk estimate; a 5-year lookback (MY-4 to MY) for the latest estimate was chosen and needs human review\"}}]}","numerator":"{\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"statin_use\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"], \"pick\": \"any\"}, \"quote\": \"prescribe a statin\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text gives no timing; statin prescription/use during the measurement year assumed; grammar has no medication type so encoded as observation of statin_use\"}}","exclusions":"[{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"cardiovascular_disease\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"primary prevention of CVD\", \"note\": \"recommendation is for primary prevention; patients with established CVD are outside scope\"}]"}],"coverage_notes":["DATE field carries an asterisk ('August 2022 *') whose footnote is not included in the section; its meaning is not represented.","The 10-year CVD risk estimate (cvd_risk_10yr) may not be reliably stored as structured data; the rule assumes a recorded risk score. The risk calculator/method is not specified and is not represented.","No lookback window for the risk estimate and no timing for the statin prescription are stated; both windows are declared as derived and require human review.","The grammar has no medication criterion type; statin_use is encoded as an observation concept.","The 'smoking' risk factor was mapped to current_smoker; the text does not say whether former smoking counts.","Statin intensity, dose, and specific statin choice are not addressed in the section and are not represented.","Exclusion of established cardiovascular disease is inferred from 'primary prevention of CVD'; other contraindications to statins (e.g., pregnancy, liver disease, intolerance) are not stated and not represented.","Related USPSTF statements (grade C for adults 40-75 with 7.5% to <10% risk; I statement for adults 76 and older) are not in this section and are not rules."]}
